name: io.github.TheoCComputationsmain/grant-consent
title: Grant · Human-in-the-loop approvals
description: Zero-custody human approval checkpoints for AI agents.

tools.name: grant.request_approval
tools.description: Create one scoped human checkpoint. Returns a private approval URL; Grant never receives credentials or payment details.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or integration asking for approval. Use a stable identifier such as 'support-agent' so the human reviewer knows which automation made the request. 1-120 characters.

tool_name.description: Exact name of the tool or action that will run after approval, for example 'send_email' or 'issue_refund'. Grant gates this action but does not execute it. 1-120 characters.

summary.description: One plain sentence describing what the human is approving. Include only non-sensitive metadata such as a recipient domain, order reference, or amount. Never include email addresses, message bodies, card numbers, credentials, or raw customer personal data. 1-500 characters.

scope.description: Optional object of non-sensitive metadata describing the request, such as channel, recipient_count, order_ref, amount, or currency. Grant stores and shows this scope to the reviewer. Never put API keys, tokens, card data, credentials, or personal data in it. Defaults to an empty object.

workspace.description: Optional workspace or organization identifier used to route the request to the correct team and feature plan. Maximum 60 characters.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL that Grant calls when the human decision is made. Requires the instant_delivery feature. Must be a valid HTTPS URL; maximum 500 characters.

callback_secret.description: Optional secret used only to sign outbound decision callbacks. It is not a user credential or payment detail and is never exposed publicly. Maximum 200 characters.

tools.name: grant.get_request
tools.description: Read the public status and signed receipt of one Grant request.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by request_human_approval or grant.request_approval. Use it to poll the public status and retrieve the signed receipt after a human decides. 1-120 characters.
